findings: The controller timed out at the independent-review barrier before transaction-ready and emitted no serving or rollout result.
The 19.9 rps two-GPU measured completion rate satisfies calibration tolerance but is not evidence of the stricter post-reclaim service-rate-greater-than-offered gate.
The 15 rps point proves one-GPU unsustainability by positive queue drift and throughput shortfall, not by a live v10 SLO breach.
